rows.grounds: the state or condition of being Brahma
having the nature or character of a fisherman; compound of dhīvara and ātmaka

items.question: What condition was relinquished when the mind assumed a fisherman's nature?
premises: The Brahma-state was the condition in question.
That Brahma-state was abandoned at that time.
The mind addressed had taken on a fisherman's nature.
items.inference: The assumption of a fisherman's nature entailed the abandonment of the Brahma-state.
uncertainties: Whether citta is best taken as a vocative address or as part of a nominative construction is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Indeed, then the Brahma-state was abandoned, O mind of fisherman-nature.
